A very important note about Bartolomé de las Casas and the African slave trade 		This issue keeps coming up and, despite my footnotes, I keep seeing commentary about it so I'm going to address it here.  		 Initially, Bartolomé de las Casas advocated the use of African slaves instead of native labor.
